cast.name: 鲍勃·奥登科克 Bob Odenkirk

this_title: Bob and David Climb Machu Picchu
introduction: But Odenkirk now tells Collider that he is taking a bit of a break from the screen, save for one project: an upcoming documentary, made alongside David Cross, that will show off the pair's ascent of the ancient Peruvian ruins of Machu Picchu.Odenkirk revealed news about the project, called Bob and David Climb Machu Picchu, during an interview with Collider's Steve Weintraub, where he was promoting his upcoming film Normal at the Toronto International Film Festival. "I'm taking a break, I'm old, I don't have nothing," Odenkirk said when asked if he had any upcoming film or television shoots. "David Cross and I climbed Machu Picchu together. In the midst of all these movies that I made in the last year and a half, David and I went to Peru and climbed Machu Picchu, and we made a documentary."
